description: This file contains the implementation of the Pickup shipping method class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines the getQuote method to determine shipping costs based on geographic zones and provides shipping method details.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Defines the Pickup shipping method class extending the core model, implementing getQuote to provide shipping options and costs.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping quote for pickup option based on geographic zone and configuration, returning shipping method details including cost and description.
